div.span: Start: scan has produced an OPEN finding / recommendation

User opens the item and reads evidence,
explanation, impact and severity reason

Preview: copy environment,
run operations on the copy

Show cost, score, availability,
compliance and config diff

Error - simulation must never
mutate the baseline

User ticks confirmation
and presses Apply?

Roll back, record REJECTED audit event,
remediation status FAILED
Re-run all rules on the changed state

Finding RESOLVED (kept in history)
Verification VERIFIED
realized saving = run-rate before - after
